description: List the workspace's preview URLs, newest page first. Pass session_id to keep only the ones bound to that sandbox (filtered here, not server-side — so it applies to the page you fetched; raise page_size or follow next_page_token to widen it). Results are paginated: a nextPageToken in the response means more pages exist.

page_token.description: Cursor from a previous response's nextPageToken.

session_id.description: Keep only preview URLs bound to this sandbox. Applied client-side to the fetched page.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to list (defaults to the key's first workspace).

name: tenki_list_preview_urls
